description: Refines a previously generated Meshy text-to-3D preview task into a final, higher-quality textured mesh. Pass the preview's `meshy_task_id`.

dispatch_mode.description: Dispatch mode. "sync" (default) blocks until the job completes. "async" submits the job and returns immediately with a job ID; poll completion via `job_get`. Named `dispatch_mode` (not bare `mode`) so it never collides with provider-specific `mode` knobs (freepik DynamicCombo, pixverse motion mode, meshy pose mode, …).

enable_pbr.description: Generate PBR maps (metallic, roughness, normal) in addition to base color. Should be false when the preview used Sculpture style.

meshy_task_id.description: The corresponding preview task id. Status of the preview task must be SUCCEEDED.

texture_prompt.description: Optional text prompt to guide texturing. Maximum 600 characters. Cannot be used at the same time as 'texture_image'.

texture_resolution.description: Base color texture resolution. Higher resolutions capture more surface detail; 8k costs 15 credits instead of 10.
